notes.title: SUGAMENIA Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers of SUGAMENIA!

We’re excited to announce that [b]Update 1.1.0[/b] is now live, bringing a host of new content! Get ready to explore a new and dangerous area, face new enemies, and solve challenging puzzles that will test your skills. It’s time to dive back into SUGAMENIA and experience everything this update has to offer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902861/4bd8445baa6cc14bcc5dff60a4e80b9506e410ef.png[/img]

[b]What’s New in Update 1.1.0:[/b]

[b]New Area: The Temple of Contamination:[/b]

[list]
[*] Venture into the Temple of Contamination, a unique area that blends the grandeur of an ancient temple with the presence of mysterious advanced technology.
[*] The atmosphere in this place is filled with toxic gases that block your path and threaten Violet’s health. Fortunately, Suichi can block the gas outlets to clear the air, allowing Violet to safely move forward and reach previously inaccessible areas.
[*] Explore hidden passages, unlock secret chambers, and discover how ancient structures intertwine with modern technology.
[/list]

[b]New Enemies:[/b]

[list]
[*] The temple’s guardians have been corrupted by the toxicity. Face new foes such as technological drones and ancient constructs, each of which will test your combat skills.
[*] Every enemy has unique attack patterns and becomes stronger in areas with a high concentration of toxic gas, making each battle more intense and strategic.
[/list]

[b]New Challenging Puzzles:[/b]

[list]
[*] Solve intricate puzzles that utilize new environmental mechanics: use Suichi to clear gases, move technological platforms, block gas outlets, and activate ancient mechanisms.
[*] Make use of Suichi’s abilities to bypass traps and discover hidden treasures that will help you upgrade your equipment and skills.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902861/0ed76a0534345e637fc3c616a8d5c759c5776a26.png[/img]

[b]Explore the Temple of Contamination Today![/b]

Update SUGAMENIA now and dive into this new and thrilling area. Use Suichi to clear the toxic environment, block gas outlets, unlock hidden paths, and face the dangers lurking within the Temple of Contamination!

As always, we appreciate your feedback and suggestions. Don’t hesitate to share your experience with us on the community forums!

[b]Thank you for being part of the adventure in SUGAMENIA![/b]

notes.title: SUGAMENIA Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello, SUGAMENIA community!

We’re excited to announce that [b]Update 1.0.4[/b] is now live. This update introduces a new [b]Hard Mode[/b] for those seeking a greater challenge, along with significant improvements to text, UI, and more. Here are all the details:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902861/2b55704e653b892bbd8a3af65c27135af57e2641.png[/img]

[h2]What’s New in Update 1.0.4[/h2]

[h3]New Hard Mode[/h3]

You can now face tougher enemies with fewer aids in the new Hard Mode, designed to push your skills to the limit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902861/0a894435b1fdd7f4dc1cf8cacc258a14c6e1ce0d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902861/409f56d62e89e5d317251e59684955322cde535c.png[/img]

[h3]Text and Localization Improvements[/h3]

We’ve revised and improved text in all available languages to ensure greater clarity and consistency.
Localization enhancements have been made to provide a more immersive experience across all languages.

[h3]User Interface (UI) Updates[/h3]

We’ve made adjustments to the UI to make it more intuitive and easier to navigate.

[h2]Check Out the New Features in Update 1.0.4 Today![/h2]

Update your game now and enjoy the new features and improvements SUGAMENIA has to offer. As always, we appreciate your feedback, so feel free to share your experience in the forums.

[b]Thank you for being part of the SUGAMENIA adventure![/b]

notes.title: SUGAMENIA Live Now! 👾
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's incredible, almost hard to believe, but finally: SUGAMENIA is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902861/27283ce7acec4b6705466ecb73daf72604e17107.png[/img]

It's been three years of development during which I have poured all my love into this project. Always with the goal of launching the game that I would like to play. I sincerely hope to connect the SUGAMENIA experience with players who are looking for a retro adventure, a challenging platformer, puzzles to make you think, and a few surprises.

As a solo developer, I would be infinitely grateful if you could share SUGAMENIA with any friend you think would enjoy an experience like this.

For all those who decide to give SUGAMENIA a chance, here is a brief summary of what you will find:

[list]
[*] A complete map divided into 10 unique areas
[*] 4 boss fights that will require all your concentration
[*] Puzzles that will make you scratch your head with unique and fun mechanics
[*] A original gameplay in the form of a travel companion (Suichi), a drone that acts as a mobile platform, bomb launcher, and more
[*] Between 3 and 4 hours of gameplay to complete your first run
[*] Retro pixel graphics reminiscent of the NES
[*] Original chiptune music
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902861/f33d52414c482661070cb9e6f7b58af59f808e63.png[/img]

Thank you for following the development of SUGAMENIA or for your interest in it now. Either way, give the experience a chance and enjoy a unique and vibrant world!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342390/SUGAMENIA/

notes.title: Full Controller Support 🎮 SUGAMENIA
notes.notes:
Hello!

I'd like to announce full controller support! The SUGAMENIA experience has been designed to be enjoyed with a controller, and now the game and the demo support all console (PlayStation, Xbox, Switch) and PC controllers.

This has been a challenge but also an absolute pleasure to finally announce!

Remember to play the free demo to get a sneak peek of SUGAMENIA!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342390/SUGAMENIA/

notes.title: Launch Date 🗺️ Map Reveal
notes.notes:
Hello! I'm here to share some good news and info. As many of you already know, SUGAMENIA has an official launch date 🥳

[h2]LAUNCH DATE: 21 JUN 2024[/h2]

I am genuinely excited to launch SUGAMENIA and for you to be able to enjoy what has been my passion for the last few years. This development journey has been incredible and I am sure that those of you who give the game a chance will have a blast.

Today I also share the blueprint of the complete map (with some blurred parts, no spoilers :)

It has been a challenge to keep the size of the map ambitious and polish every corner, every jump, every platform to reach the game that I would like to play as a passionate gamer.

I have put all my love into each puzzle so that the experience is optimal. Leave me your expectations regarding the map in comments, I read you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902861/4e103ba8ce3450fcd67b24e3a3dbc3e714b141c8.png[/img]
